        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if(!type){\n    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid type\")}&#96;, request.url));\n  }\n  if(!token_hash){\n    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL(&#96;/auth/error?error=${encodeURIComponent(\"Invalid token hash\")}&#96;, request.url));\n  }\n\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  if (token_hash &amp;&amp; type) {\n    const supabase = createServerClient(\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n      process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n      {\n        cookies: {\n          getAll() {\n            return request.cookies.getAll();\n          },\n          setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n              request.cookies.set(name, value);\n            });\n            supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n              request,\n            });\n            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n              supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n            });\n          },\n        },\n      },\n    );\n\n    const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from \"next/server\";\nimport { isPublicRoute } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\nexport async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  // If the env vars are not set, skip proxy check. You can remove this\n  // once you setup the project.\n\n  // With Fluid compute, don't put this client in a global environment\n  // variable.         "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\n/**\n * Google OAuth login button component\n * Handles both sign-in and sign-up flows seamlessly\n */\nexport function GoogleLoginButton() {\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleGoogleLogin = async () =&gt; {\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    const supabase = createClient();\n\n    try {\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({\n        provider: \"google\",\n        options: {\n          redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/callback&#96;,\n        },\n      });\n\n      if (error) {\n        console.error(\"Google OAuth error:\", error);\n        setIsLoading(false);\n      }\n      // Note: User will be redirected to Google, so we don't reset loading state here\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error(\"Unexpected error:\", error);\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Button\n      type=\"button\"\n      onClick={handleGoogleLogin}\n      disabled={isLoading}\n      className=\"w-full\"\n      variant=\"outline\"\n    &gt;\n      {isLoading ?         "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from \"react\";\nimport { type User } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { GoogleLoginButton } from \"@/components/google-login-button\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Badge } from \"@/components/ui/badge\";\n\n/**\n * Client component for auth restrictions testing\n * Tests:\n * - Google OAuth signup (should work)\n * - Email/password signup (should be blocked)\n * - OTP email signup (should be blocked)\n * - Email identity addition (should validate CZU domain)\n */\nexport function AuthTestPageClient() {\n  const [user, setUser] = useState&lt;User | null&gt;(null);\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [testResults, setTestResults] = useState&lt;{\n    emailPassword?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n    emailOTP?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n    emailIdentity?: { success: boolean; message: string };\n  }&gt;({});\n\n  const supabase = useMemo(() =&gt; createClient(), []);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    checkUser();\n    const {\n      data: { subscription },\n    } = supabase.auth.onAuthStateChange(() =&gt; {\n      checkUser();\n    });\n\n    return () =&gt; {\n      subscription.unsubscribe();\n    };\n  }, [supabase]);\n\n  const checkUser = async () =&gt; {\n    const {\n      data: { user: currentUser },\n    } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n    setUser(currentUser);\n    setLoading(false);\n  };\n\n  const testEmailPasswordSignup = async (e: React.FormEvent&lt;HTMLFormElement&gt;)\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10\"&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "[auth.third_party.auth0]\nenabled = false\n# tenant = \"my-auth0-tenant\"\n# tenant_region = \"us\"\n\n# Use AWS Cognito (Amplify) as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.aws_cognito]\nenabled = false\n# user_pool_id = \"my-user-pool-id\"\n# user_pool_region = \"us-east-1\"\n\n# Use Clerk as a third-party provider alongside Supabase Auth.\n[auth.third_party.clerk]\nenabled = false\n# Obtain from https://clerk.com/setup/supabase\n# domain = \"example.clerk.accounts.dev\"\n\n# OAuth server configuration\n[auth.oauth_server]\n# Enable OAuth server functionality\nenabled = false\n# Path for OAuth consent flow UI\nauthorization_url_path = \"/oauth/consent\"\n# Allow dynamic client registration\nallow_dynamic_registration = false\n\n[edge_runtime]\nenabled = true\n# Supported request policies: &#96;oneshot&#96;, &#96;per_worker&#96;.\n# &#96;per_worker&#96; (default) — enables hot reload during local development.\n# &#96;oneshot&#96; — fallback mode if hot reload causes issues (e.g. in large repos or with symlinks).\npolicy = \"per_worker\"\n# Port to attach the Chrome inspector for debugging edge functions.\ninspector_port = 8083\n# The Deno major version to use.\ndeno_version = 2\n\n# [edge_runtime.secrets]\n# secret_key = \"env(SECRET_VALUE)\"\n\n[analytics]\nenabled = true\nport = 54327\n# Configure one of the supported backends: &#96;postgres&#96;, &#96;bigquery&#96;.\nbackend = \"postgres\"\n\n# Experimental features may be deprecated any time\n[experimental]\n# Configures Postgres storage engine to use OrioleDB (S3)\norioledb_version = \"\"\n# Configures S3 bucket URL, eg. &lt;bucket_name&gt;.s3-&lt;region&gt;.amazonaws.com\ns3_host = \"env(S3_HOST)\"\n# Configures S3 bucket region, eg. us-east-1\ns3_region = \"env(S3_REGION)\"\n# Configures AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID for S3 bucket\ns3_access_key = \"env(S3_ACCESS_KEY)\"\n# Configures AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY for S3 bucket\ns3_secret_key = \"env(S3_SECRET_KEY)\"",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/config.toml",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {
            "line": 107
          },
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 170
          }

        "contents": "file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n\n# Uncomment to configure local storage buckets\n# [storage.buckets.images]\n# public = false\n# file_size_limit = \"50MiB\"\n# allowed_mime_types = [\"image/png\", \"image/jpeg\"]\n# objects_path = \"./images\"\n\n# Allow connections via S3 compatible clients\n[storage.s3_protocol]\nenabled = true\n\n# Image transformation API is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.image_transformation]\n# enabled = true\n\n# Store analytical data in S3 for running ETL jobs over Iceberg Catalog\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.analytics]\nenabled = false\nmax_namespaces = 5\nmax_tables = 10\nmax_catalogs = 2\n\n# Analytics Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.analytics.buckets.my-warehouse]\n\n# Store vector embeddings in S3 for large and durable datasets\n# This feature is only available on the hosted platform.\n[storage.vector]\nenabled = false\nmax_buckets = 10\nmax_indexes = 5\n\n# Vector Buckets is available to Supabase Pro plan.\n# [storage.vector.buckets.documents-openai]\n\n[auth]\nenabled = true\n# The base URL of your website.         "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  const identities = authUser.identities || [];\n  const hasEmailIdentity = identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  if (!hasEmailIdentity) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Get the public.users row and linked profile in a single query\n  const { data: publicUser } = await supabase\n    .from(\"users\")\n    .select(\"id, profiles(id)\")\n    .eq(\"auth_user_id\", user.sub)\n    .single();\n\n  // If no publicUser or no linked profile, redirect to pending approval\n  if (!publicUser || !publicUser.profiles || publicUser.profiles.length === 0) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    return NextResponse.redirect(url);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "import { EnvVarWarning } from \"@/components/env-var-warning\";\nimport { AuthButton } from \"@/components/auth-button\";\nimport { ThemeSwitcher } from \"@/components/theme-switcher\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { Suspense } from \"react\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/server\";\nimport { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\nexport default async function ProtectedLayout({\n  children,\n}: {\n  children: React.ReactNode;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity();\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;main className=\"min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center\"&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function ForgotPasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // The url which will be included in the email. This URL needs to be configured in your redirect URLs in the Supabase dashboard at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/auth/url-configuration\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

{\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to protected page\n      router.push(\"/protected\");\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt;         "contents": "template = \"Your code is {{ .Code }}\"\n# Controls the minimum amount of time that must pass before sending another sms otp.\nmax_frequency = \"5s\"\n\n# Use pre-defined map of phone number to OTP for testing.\n# [auth.sms.test_otp]\n# 4152127777 = \"123456\"\n\n# Configure logged in session timeouts.\n# [auth.sessions]\n# Force log out after the specified duration.\n# timebox = \"24h\"\n# Force log out if the user has been inactive longer than the specified duration.\n# inactivity_timeout = \"8h\"\n\n# This hook runs before a new user is created and allows developers to reject the request based on the incoming user object.\n[auth.hook.before_user_created]\nenabled = true\nuri = \"pg-functions://postgres/public/before_user_created_hook\"\n\n# This hook runs before a token is issued and allows you to add additional claims based on the authentication method used.\n# [auth.hook.custom_access_token]\n# enabled = true\n# uri = \"pg-functions://&lt;database&gt;/&lt;schema&gt;/&lt;hook_name&gt;\"\n\n# Configure one of the supported SMS providers: &#96;twilio&#96;, &#96;twilio_verify&#96;, &#96;messagebird&#96;, &#96;textlocal&#96;, &#96;vonage&#96;.\n[auth.sms.twilio]\nenabled = false\naccount_sid = \"\"\nmessage_service_sid = \"\"\n# DO NOT commit your Twilio auth token to git.         "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has an email identity linked\n * (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n * @param supabaseClient - Optional Supabase client to use. If not provided, creates a new client.\n * @returns true if user has an email identity, false otherwise\n */\nexport async function hasEmailIdentity(\n  supabaseClient?: Awaited&lt;ReturnType&lt;typeof createClient&gt;&gt;\n): Promise&lt;boolean&gt; {\n  const supabase = supabaseClient ?? await createClient();\n  const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n  if (error || !user) {\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth)\n  // User identities include: email, google, etc.\n  // We need at least one email identity\n  const identities = user.identities || [];\n\n  // Check if any identity is an email identity (not OAuth)\n  return identities.some(\n    (identity) =&gt; identity.provider === \"email\"\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Checks if the authenticated user has a linked profile\n * @returns true if user has a linked profile, false otherwise\n */",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\n\nexport function LogoutButton() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n\n  const logout = async () =&gt; {\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    await supabase.auth.signOut();\n    router.push(\"/auth/login\");\n  };\n\n  return &lt;Button onClick={logout}&gt;Logout&lt;/Button&gt;;\n}",

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
